artifact_policy: Persist raw body-codegen stdout/stderr, emitted Go, raw Go test stdout/stderr, training-only fixture and plan copies, and hash-bound receipts. Do not include any held-out vectors.

probe_policy.workflow_passes_when: the emitted source compiles, all training observations match the expected known-bad outputs, and every test mismatch is exactly the declared training mismatch

planned_selection_treatments.definition: Use original intent and training suite without external failure context.
Append a bounded training-failure summary to intent only after exact compiler, fixture, activity, plan, and emitted-source provenance matches.
Reject stale source context before injection, then make the selection request with the unchanged base intent.

selection_design.holdout_policy: Open independent finite holdout vectors only after all selection requests and responses are saved.

scope_limits: One deterministic candidate and one bounded attempt per intent.
Finite training behavior only; no full-domain correctness claim.
This workflow validates an external Go test probe and evidence binding; internal Gooo evaluation is not treated as external CI authority.
The initial GitHub Actions workflow only verifies training-only CI failure evidence; selection results are a separately captured local offline Laya study.
